behavior_proved: manager settings updates return one immutable outcome containing settings, applied, bindingChanged, and the matching status snapshot
the controller computes binding changes from the pre-update snapshot and validated persisted configuration, then publishes the outcome under the existing serialized mutation lease
deferred updates report applied=false without invoking runtime application while preserving the binding-change result
applied updates report status only after runtime apply or rebind has completed and the new configuration is published
failed updates return no value rather than a partially reconstructed outcome
the named-pipe protocol uses the distinct settings_update result discriminator and a closed four-field value object
protocol decoding rejects malformed or inconsistent nested settings and status values while preserving all four valid boolean combinations
the Windows named-pipe client requires the exact settings-update outcome variant and round trips all outcome fields for both applied and deferred binding changes
manager controller, protocol, dispatcher, Windows infrastructure, named-pipe round trip, process-host, contract fake, and header-isolation builds agree on the new contract
